label: Town of Royalton
header:
# Town of Royalton municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 20; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Royalton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk; 390 ballots cast): Allison N. Fulcher was elected Moderator with 362 votes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk; Royalton elects its clerk to a three-year term
Town of Royalton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk; 390 ballots cast): Karmen Bascom was elected Town Clerk with 373 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Karmen Bascom as Royalton's Town Clerk
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 145 (Town of Royalton): the Town Treasurer is appointed by the Selectboard (term of up to three years, at the pleasure of the board); the charter's only section
Town of Royalton, 2025 Town Report, Elected Town Officers and Appointed Officers tables: Rita Hull is listed among the town's appointed officers as Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Rita Hull as Royalton's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Royalton's five selectboard members: Kip Bergstrom, Patrick Dakin, Nell Gwin, Tim Parker II (styled 'Selectboard-Appointment through March 2027'), and Larry Trottier

Town of Royalton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk; 390 ballots cast): Nell Gwin was re-elected to a two-year seat (323 votes) and Christopher 'Kip' Bergstrom won the three-year seat (198 votes)

Town of Royalton, Selectboard minutes of March 10, 2026: the board organized with Patrick Dakin as Chair and Larry Trottier as Vice Chair, with Bergstrom seated. Tim Parker II holds the fifth seat by appointment (see the directory note); he fills the seat Robert A. Gray, Jr. held at the March 10 meeting before departing

offices.title: Lister
offices.org_name: Town of Royalton Board of Listers

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three

Town of Royalton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk; 390 ballots cast): Walter Hastings was re-elected a lister (340 votes); the one-year remainder lister seat drew no ballot candidate (write-ins 30, blanks 360), so it is left unfilled
Town of Royalton, 2025 Town Report, Elected Town Officers and Appointed Officers tables: Jeffrey Barcelow's lister term runs to 2028

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Royalton Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes for a one-year term unless the town votes a longer term
Town of Royalton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk; 390 ballots cast): Theresa Harrington was elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes with 357 votes
Town of Royalton, Collector of Delinquent Taxes page (royaltonvt.gov): Theresa Harrington is the Collector of Delinquent Taxes

offices.title: Trustee of Public Funds
offices.org_name: Town of Royalton Trustees of Public Funds

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect trustees of public funds where the town holds public funds

Town of Royalton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk; 390 ballots cast): Donna Bohonnon was re-elected a trustee of public funds (347 votes) and Jerry Barcelow won the two-year remainder seat (359 votes); Barcelow had been appointed to the seat in 2025
Town of Royalton, 2025 Town Report, Elected Town Officers and Appointed Officers tables: John P. Dumville's trustee of public funds term runs to 2027

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a first constable; Royalton elects its constables to two-year terms); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Royalton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk; 390 ballots cast): the two-year first constable seat drew no ballot candidate (write-ins 67, no winner certified), so the post is created without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns may elect a second constable
Town of Royalton, 2025 Town Report, Elected Town Officers and Appointed Officers tables: Linc Farrington's second constable term runs to 2027; the seat did not stand in 2026
Town of Royalton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk; 390 ballots cast): Heather Leavitt was re-elected a cemetery commissioner (350 votes)
Town of Royalton, Cemetery Commission page (royaltonvt.gov): the commissioners are Josephine Levasseur (term to 2028), Kenneth Alton (to 2027), and Heather Leavitt
Town of Royalton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk; 390 ballots cast): Steven W. Hall was re-elected a library trustee (339 votes) to a two-year seat

Town of Royalton, 2025 Town Report, Elected Town Officers and Appointed Officers tables: the library trustees table lists exactly two trustees -- Steven W. Hall and Fran Flannery (term to 2027) -- with one two-year seat elected each year, so the board has two seats
